cycle_review_kind_keys.name: cycle_review_kind_keys
cycle_review_kind_keys.value: (kind = 'cycle') = (cycle_group_id IS NOT NULL AND phase_cycle_index IS NOT NULL)

cycle_set_target_rpe_min.name: cycle_set_target_rpe_min
cycle_set_target_rpe_min.value: target_rpe_min IS NULL OR target_rpe_min BETWEEN 6 AND 10

cycle_set_target_rpe_max.name: cycle_set_target_rpe_max
cycle_set_target_rpe_max.value: target_rpe_max IS NULL OR target_rpe_max BETWEEN 6 AND 10

cycle_set_percent_tm.name: cycle_set_percent_tm
cycle_set_percent_tm.value: load_type <> 'percent_tm' OR load_percent IS NOT NULL

cycle_set_fixed.name: cycle_set_fixed
cycle_set_fixed.value: load_type <> 'fixed' OR fixed_load_kg IS NOT NULL

cycle_set_top_set.name: cycle_set_top_set
cycle_set_top_set.value:
load_type <> 'top_set' OR (load_percent IS NOT NULL AND target_rpe_max IS NOT NULL
                                    AND reps_max IS NOT NULL AND reps_max <= 5
                                    AND is_amrap = 0 AND is_warmup = 0)

cycle_set_reps.name: cycle_set_reps
cycle_set_reps.value: reps_min IS NULL OR reps_max IS NULL OR reps_min <= reps_max

phase_volume_factor.name: phase_volume_factor
phase_volume_factor.value: volume_factor IS NULL OR volume_factor BETWEEN 0.1 AND 1

phase_load_factor.name: phase_load_factor
phase_load_factor.value: load_factor IS NULL OR load_factor BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1

phase_rpe_cap.name: phase_rpe_cap
phase_rpe_cap.value: rpe_cap IS NULL OR rpe_cap BETWEEN 6 AND 10

phase_rest_days_at_end.name: phase_rest_days_at_end
phase_rest_days_at_end.value: rest_days_at_end IS NULL OR rest_days_at_end BETWEEN 2 AND 7

phase_continuation.name: phase_continuation
phase_continuation.value:
continues_phase_id IS NULL OR (type = 'training' AND continues_offset_weeks IS NOT NULL
                                         AND continues_offset_weeks >= 1)

session_rpe.name: session_rpe
session_rpe.value: rpe IS NULL OR rpe BETWEEN 1 AND 10

set_log_rpe.name: set_log_rpe
set_log_rpe.value: rpe IS NULL OR (rpe BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND rpe * 2 = CAST(rpe * 2 AS INTEGER))
